enum.name: AMOV_DEVICE_OPERATION
enum.description: Transport operations only. Device business operations are opaque payload bytes.

enum.name: AMOV_DEVICE_STATUS
enum.description: Communication result only, never a device save or activation result.

message.name: AMOV_DEVICE_REQUEST
message.description: Bounded transparent device request. LIST_NODES has an empty payload; TRANSFER carries an opaque device service request. MAVLink 2 only.
message.field: Nonzero random ground station connection session.
Target DroneCAN node 1 to 127 for TRANSFER; zero for LIST_NODES.
Number of valid payload bytes, 0 to 192.
Opaque device request bytes; unused bytes zero.

message.name: AMOV_DEVICE_RESPONSE
message.description: Response routed to the original ground station on the original connection. LIST_NODES returns one live CAN node ID per payload byte. Device result bytes are not interpreted by the bridge.
message.field: Nonzero random ground station connection session.
Target DroneCAN node 1 to 127 for TRANSFER; zero for LIST_NODES.
Number of valid payload bytes, 0 to 192.
Transport result. OK does not imply a successful device operation.
Opaque device response, or node list. Unused bytes zero.
